description: This file defines a class for vector search in MongoDB Atlas, including methods for adding vectors/documents, similarity search, MMR, and deletion, utilizing MongoDB client and various utility functions.

classes.name: MongoDBAtlasVectorSearch
classes.description: A class for performing vector similarity search and management in MongoDB Atlas, supporting vector addition, search, deletion, and MMR-based retrieval.

methods.name: _vectorstoreType
methods.description: Returns the type of vector store, here 'mongodb_atlas'.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with embeddings and configuration arguments.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MongoDB client instance.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the provided MongoDB client connection.

methods.name: addVectors
methods.description: Adds vectors and associated documents to the MongoDB collection, with optional IDs.

methods.name: addDocuments
methods.description: Converts documents to vectors and adds them to the collection.

methods.name: similaritySearchVectorWithScore
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search with scoring, returning documents with scores.

methods.name: maxMarginalRelevanceSearch
methods.description: Performs a Max Marginal Relevance search to diversify results based on query embedding.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes documents from the collection by IDs.

methods.name: fromTexts
methods.description: Creates an instance from raw texts and metadata.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates an instance from existing documents.

methods.name: fixArrayPrecision
methods.description: Adjusts numerical array values for precision issues.
